tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List all supported European bidding zones with codes, names, and capabilities. No auth required.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Day-ahead electricity prices in each zone's native currency and native market resolution. Requires an API key; Home starts at voltcast.com/register?plan=home.

tools.name: get_realtime_prices
tools.description: Explicitly labeled real-time market prices (currently WEIM), kept separate from day-ahead curves. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Probabilistic price forecast (P50 curve; P10/P90 on Pro+) up to 7 days ahead. Home and grandfathered Free keys are scoped to their selected zone. Accuracy published daily at voltcast.com/accuracy.

tools.name: get_carbon
tools.description: Carbon intensity (gCO2eq/kWh) and green score (0-100 low-carbon share) derived from the live generation mix.

tools.name: get_renewables
tools.description: Day-ahead wind + solar generation forecasts: the TSO's official forecast AND Voltcast's own model (volt-res-1) with q10-q90 bands, beside realized generation, with head-to-head verification (who beats whom, disclosed). Pro/Scale.

tools.name: cheapest_window
tools.description: Rank Home+ action windows by household cost. Experimental carbon/balanced modes use a disclosed trailing historical production-mix profile—not a forward carbon forecast—and support no emissions-reduction claim.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
